info.name: SCRUM-128 Location intelligence
info.description: Manual checks for GET /api/properties/id/{id}/location-intelligence (schools, transport and risk in one response). Run in order. Set password and adminPassword; set completePropertyId to a property with data and emptyPropertyId to one without any. The complete and partial responses are saved as examples on request 03. Contract: docs/location-intelligence.md.

item.name: 01 Token for a normal user (Keycloak password grant)
03 Complete: property with school, transport and risk data (200, COMPLETE)

request.description: Property with data in the three sections. Saved examples: "Complete" (this request) and "Partial" (the same property while the school table could not be read and the transport source was down; it cannot be reproduced without breaking the database, so it is documented as an example only).

exec: pm.test('the three sections and an errors list', () => { pm.expect(r).to.have.property('schools'); pm.expect(r).to.have.property('transport'); pm.expect(r).to.have.property('risk'); pm.expect(r.errors).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('COMPLETE, no section error', () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('COMPLETE'); pm.expect(r.errors).to.have.length(0); });

pm.test('sections answered with their own statuses', () => { pm.expect(['AVAILABLE','NO_NEARBY_RESULTS','NO_COVERAGE']).to.include(r.schools.status); pm.expect(['AVAILABLE','NO_COVERAGE']).to.include(r.transport.status); pm.expect(['AVAILABLE','NO_COVERAGE']).to.include(r.risk.status); });
pm.test('every section names its source or blocks', () => { pm.expect(r.schools.source).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(r.transport.source).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: 04 Empty data: property without school, transport or parcel data (200, COMPLETE with NO_COVERAGE sections)

exec: pm.test('the three sections and an errors list', () => { pm.expect(r).to.have.property('schools'); pm.expect(r).to.have.property('transport'); pm.expect(r).to.have.property('risk'); pm.expect(r.errors).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('COMPLETE: no data is an answer, not an error', () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('COMPLETE'); pm.expect(r.errors).to.have.length(0); });

pm.test('each section says NO_COVERAGE with a note', () => { ['schools','transport','risk'].forEach(s => { pm.expect(r[s].status).to.eql('NO_COVERAGE'); pm.expect(r[s].note).to.be.a('string'); }); });

item.name: 05 Any role: the admin reads the same property (200)

exec: pm.test('same answer as for the normal user', () => pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('COMPLETE'));
pm.test('message explains', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("No property found with id"));
pm.test('message explains', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("id must be a positive number"));
pm.test('message explains', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("id must be a positive number"));
